text_en: If, in the land that the Lord your God is giving you to possess, a body is found lying in open country, and it is not known who struck the person down,
text_cn: 如果上主你的天主赐给你作产业的地方，发现有人被杀，曝尸原野，却不知道是谁杀了他，

text_en: then your elders and your judges shall come out to measure the distances to the towns that are near the body.
text_cn: 你的长老和官长应出来，从被杀者测量到四周各城，

text_en: The elders of the town nearest the body shall take a heifer that has never been worked, one that has not pulled in the yoke;
text_cn: 看哪一座城离被杀者最近；然后这城的长老应牵来一头尚未耕作，尚未负轭（è）的母牛犊。

text_en: the elders of that town shall bring the heifer down to a wadi with running water, which is neither plowed nor sown, and shall break the heifer’s neck there in the wadi.
text_cn: 这城的长老应把母牛犊牵到尚未耕耘播种的地方，靠近常流的溪水旁，就在那溪水上砍断母牛犊的颈。

text_en: Then the priests, the sons of Levi, shall come forward, for the Lord your God has chosen them to minister to him and to pronounce blessings in the name of the Lord , and by their decision all cases of dispute and assault shall be settled.
text_cn: 肋未的子孙司祭们应上前来，因为上主你的天主拣选了他们为事奉自己，因上主之名颁赐祝福，所以一切争论殴打的事，都应凭他们的裁判来决断。

text_en: All the elders of that town nearest the body shall wash their hands over the heifer whose neck was broken in the wadi,
text_cn: 那离被杀者最近城市的长老，都应用溪水在被砍断颈项的母牛犊身上洗手，

text_en: and they shall declare: “Our hands did not shed this blood, nor were we witnesses to it.
text_cn: 同时声明说：“这血不是我们的手流的，我们的眼也没有看见。

text_en: Absolve, O Lord , your people Israel, whom you redeemed; do not let the guilt of innocent blood remain in the midst of your people Israel. ” Then they will be absolved of bloodguilt.
text_cn: 上主！求你赦免你所救赎的以色列人民，不要让这流无辜血的罪债，留在你以色列人民中间。”这样他们算是赎了流血的罪。

text_en: So you shall purge the guilt of innocent blood from your midst, because you must do what is right in the sight of the Lord .
text_cn: 你由你中间也除去了流无辜血的罪，因为你行了上主眼中视为正直的事。

text_en: When you go out to war against your enemies, and the Lord your God hands them over to you and you take them captive,
text_cn: 当你出征进攻你的敌人时，上主你的天主将他们交在你手中，你获得了一些俘虏；

text_en: suppose you see among the captives a beautiful woman whom you desire and want to marry,
text_cn: 你若在俘虏中看见了一个容貌美好的女人，对她爱恋不舍，愿娶她为妻，

text_en: and so you bring her home to your house: she shall shave her head, pare her nails,
text_cn: 你可带她到你家中，叫她剃去头发，剪短指甲，

text_en: discard her captive’s garb, and shall remain in your house a full month, mourning for her father and mother; after that you may go in to her and be her husband, and she shall be your wife.
text_cn: 脱去自己被掳时所穿的衣服，住在你家里，哀悼她的父母一个月；然后，你才能亲近她：你做她的丈夫，她做你的妻子。

text_en: But if you are not satisfied with her, you shall let her go free and not sell her for money. You must not treat her as a slave, since you have dishonored her.
text_cn: 以后如果你不喜欢她，应让她随意离去，决不能将她卖钱，也不能以她为奴，因为你曾玷污了她。

text_en: If a man has two wives, one of them loved and the other disliked, and if both the loved and the disliked have borne him sons, the firstborn being the son of the one who is disliked,
text_cn: 一人如有两妻，一为所爱，一为所恶，所爱所恶的，都给他生了儿子；但是长子却是他所恶的妻子生的，

text_en: then on the day when he wills his possessions to his sons, he is not permitted to treat the son of the loved as the firstborn in preference to the son of the disliked, who is the firstborn.
text_cn: 在他将自己的产业分给他的儿子的那一天，不能将爱妻的儿子视作长子，而废弃所恶妻子所生的长子；

text_en: He must acknowledge as firstborn the son of the one who is disliked, giving him a double portion of all that he has; since he is the first issue of his virility, the right of the firstborn is his.
text_cn: 必须承认所恶妻子的儿子为长子，将所有的产业，多分给他一份，因为他是自己壮年时的首生子，应获得长子的权利。

text_en: If someone has a stubborn and rebellious son who will not obey his father and mother, who does not heed them when they discipline him,
text_cn: 人若有一个忤逆不孝的儿子，不听从父母的劝告，责罚他以后仍不听从，

text_en: then his father and his mother shall take hold of him and bring him out to the elders of his town at the gate of that place.
text_cn: 父母就该将他捉住，带到当地的城门前，见本城的长老，

text_en: They shall say to the elders of his town, “This son of ours is stubborn and rebellious. He will not obey us. He is a glutton and a drunkard. ”
text_cn: 对本城的长老说：“我们这个儿子忤逆不孝，不听我们的劝告，是个放荡的酒徒。”

text_en: Then all the men of the town shall stone him to death. So you shall purge the evil from your midst; and all Israel will hear, and be afraid.
text_cn: 本城的众人就应用石头将他砸死：这样，由你中间铲除了这邪恶，每个以色列人听了，必然害怕。

text_en: When someone is convicted of a crime punishable by death and is executed, and you hang him on a tree,
text_cn: 若人犯了该死的罪，处死以后，应将他悬在木杆上，

text_en: his corpse must not remain all night upon the tree; you shall bury him that same day, for anyone hung on a tree is under God’s curse. You must not defile the land that the Lord your God is giving you for possession.
text_cn: 但不可让他的尸体在木杆上过夜，应在当天将他埋葬。因为凡被悬者，是天主所咒骂的；你不可玷污上主你的天主赐给你作产业的土地。
